definition.note: StructDef → cdef class：cdef public 字段 + __init__ + cpdef/cdef 方法。对齐 PyO3 #[pyclass] + #[pymethods]。

preconditions: s.name 必须是合法标识符
s.fields 每个元素含 name 和 ty
s.methods 每个元素是合法 FnDef

tests.expected:
cdef class Point:
    cdef public double x
    cdef public double y
    def __init__(self, double x, double y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

cdef class Circle:
    cdef public double r
    def __init__(self, double r):
        self.r = r
    cpdef double area(self):
        return self.r * self.r * 3.14
